claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 µM, TWS-119 inhibits GSK3β, leading to β-catenin stabilization and Wnt pathway activation, and may also reduce GSK3β-dependent NF-κB signaling; this is expected to cause selective cytotoxicity in sensitive cancer lines rather than broad killing.
